_comment: Damage calculation configuration for Omega Realm combat (player->monster, monster->player, ability AOE/DoT). Holds the formula coefficients and modifier order used to turn a base damage value plus attacker/target stats into final damage. The Rust omega-server (sim_core hit pass + combat.rs) is the numeric authority and computes all damage server-side ('the client requests, the server decides'); this file mirrors the config for client tooltips/tooling and the server wins on disagreement. Governing GDD docs: docs/systems/combat-hits.md, docs/systems/abilities.md, docs/server/contract.md. TODO: all formula coefficients and the modifier pipeline are unfilled pending design; the example below is schema-shape only. Today combat is flat (primary damage_base/per_level per class, ability flat damage) with no armor/resist/crit layer in code.

global._comment: Top-level toggles/order. TODO: confirm whether armor, resistances, crit exist at all.

formulas._comment: One schema-shaped example. Replace coefficients when design lands. Add one entry per damage channel (primary, ability, dot, monster_attack).

variables.flat_bonus: sum of additive flat damage affixes
variables.percent_bonus: sum of multiplicative damage affixes (0.0 = none)

physical.notes: TODO: design value unknown; current code applies flat base damage only

crit._comment: Critical hit config, if any. TODO: undecided.
